name: Flat cheese
summary: Flat yellow cheese wedge with holes and a small cube, or a cheese wheel. For breakfast, cheese board or snack scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the cheese rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~380 px wide); use about 0.2 to 0.3 next to a person

params.name: variant
params.note: wedge = triangle with a small cube, wheel = round cheese

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = slight rock, pop = scale in

author: krakujs
